purpose: Reusable source navigation and per-feature porting preparation; not a host compatibility certification

source.reference_policy: Detached, unchanged checkout at the specified commit; not part of Hchat build
source.root_license_text: GNU General Public License version 3; individual files and submodules must be checked separately

target_analysis.known_recent_host_evidence: WeChat 8.0.80 (3220); this is an evidence baseline, not a global version allowlist
target_analysis.current_tree_policy: Read current Hchat source and local changes for every task; do not reset to this analysis commit

index.method: Static source object scan following BaseFeature subtype declarations; not a compiled KSP registry
index.dependency_scope: Lexical and import navigation hints; per-feature transitive/runtime closure still requires source review

update_policy: Keep each feature task pinned to an explicit source commit. A task using newer upstream code records its override in its own source card and uses a separate reference checkout; it does not relabel the whole index. A full baseline update must regenerate the index, counts and affected documentation together. Verify target source against current Hchat.
